recentItems.title: Comedian Carrot Top Receiving "Care and Support" After Being Hospitalized In Las Vegas
recentItems.description: Carrot Top’s rep confirmed the entertainer was hospitalized in Las Vegas, telling Entertainment Weekly in a statement, expressing that he is recovering.

recentItems.title: Great British Bake Off’s Nigella Lawson Sets the Record Straight on Paul Hollywood Feud Rumors
recentItems.description: Great British Bake Off’s Nigella Lawson slammed rumors that she and her fellow judge Paul Hollywood have beef: “It surprised even us, I think, how well we hit it off.”

recentItems.title: Colin Farrell Looks Nearly Unrecognizable With Shaved Head Transformation
recentItems.description: Colin Farrell looked so different as he stepped out in Los Angeles Sept. 16 with a shaved haircut, doing away with his signature brunette tresses for his shortest look in years.

recentItems.title: Kelly Osbourne Debuts Dark Hair With Asymmetric Bangs at OnlyFans Show
recentItems.description: Kelly Osbourne showed off her hair transformation at London Fashion Week, walking OnlyFans and Natasha Zinko's runway show with a short black bob featuring asymmetric bangs that only covered one eye.

recentItems.title: Gwyneth Paltrow Reveals the Real Story Behind Her and Chris Martin’s “Conscious Uncoupling”
recentItems.description: Gwyneth Paltrow revealed the origins of her and ex-husband Chris Martin’s 2014 breakup, explaining the idea was based around putting kids Apple, 22, and Moses, 20, first.

recentItems.title: Mayim Bialik Reacts to Fans Who Don't Want Her in ‘Big Bang Theory’ Spinoff
recentItems.description: ‘The Big Bang Theory’ alum Mayim Bialik shared how she felt about fans who didn't want her appearing on the new spinoff, ‘Stuart Fails to Save the Universe’: "I just got a good laugh out of that."
